items.quote: And the LORD spake unto Moses in mount Sinai, saying,
items.claim: The text says the LORD spoke to Moses at Mount Sinai. This frames the law that follows as speech from God.

items.quote: When ye come into the land which I give you, then shall the land keep a sabbath unto the LORD.
items.claim: The children of Israel are told that once they enter the land given to them, the land must keep a sabbath to the LORD.
items.place: the land which I give you
